description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigurationProvider class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling regional endpoint configurations for AWS STS. It includes methods for creating configuration providers based on environment variables, ini files, and fallback defaults, as well as mechanisms for caching and unwrapping configuration objects.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides configuration for AWS STS regional endpoints, supporting environment variables, ini files, caching, and default fallbacks.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, ini files, and fallback options, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider based on environment variables.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides fallback configuration options when other sources are not set.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider based on a specified ini file and profile.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Converts various configuration representations into a ConfigurationInterface object.
